definitions.gloss: plain clothes, casual clothes, civilian clothes
definitions.explanation: Ordinary everyday clothing as opposed to a uniform, work clothes, or official attire.

examples.english: I came in plain clothes today.
I spend days off in casual clothes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{私服|しふく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: This school has no uniform, so students attend in their own clothes every day.

notes:
{私服|しふく} refers to personal, everyday clothing worn outside of official duties, school, or work — as opposed to a uniform or formal attire.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {私服|しふく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to commute/attend in plain clothes
- {私服|しふく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to come in casual clothes
- {私服|しふく}⟦{警官|けいかん}→警官：02876_keikan⟧: plainclothes police officer
- {私服|しふく}⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧: working in plain clothes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧: uniform (school, work)
- ⟦{作業着|さぎょうぎ}→作業着：24135_sagyougi⟧: work clothes
- ⟦{正装|せいそう}→正装：16053_seisou⟧: formal attire

USAGE:
In Japan, many schools require ⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧ (uniforms), so {私服|しふく} often comes up in discussions about school dress codes. A {私服|しふく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧ is a school without a uniform policy.
